next.reason: 1985: "A control heading or detail report group ... from the line number specified by integer-3 to the line number specified by integer-4, inclusive."; 2023: "d) The lower limit for a control heading is the line given by the LAST CONTROL HEADING integer.". Other regions match. 2023 adds a LAST CONTROL HEADING limit, which may be below LAST DETAIL, so control headings can be confined more tightly than details. It defaults to LAST DETAIL.
